summary: Document GLM QAD TP2 serving and the optional shared gate/up activation scale
details: The online-quantization example keeps source calibration by default and specifies a 3072-token prefill budget, 4 GiB FP8 KV per rank and one loading CPU thread per worker.
The activation-scale report records public-image serving, the small measured prefill benefit, unchanged down-input scales, and bounded quality evidence. Sharing remains opt-in.
